definition: a large group of people packed together
description: A run of street-dance scenes. A breakdancer flips upside down on a sunny city plaza inside a ring of people who clap and film him. Then women in wide rainbow-coloured folk skirts spin in the middle of a street while onlookers press in on both sides. Next about ten dancers move as one down the aisle of a shopping centre, with shoppers gathering along the sides. Finally the camera lifts to show hundreds of people filling a whole city square at dusk, all dancing the same steps in rows that run back to the buildings.

de.answer: Die Menschenmenge tanzt auf dem Platz.
